prompt: Create ONE single landscape image: a 3x3 grid of 9 SEPARATE illustrations for a children's picture book (3 columns, 3 rows), plain white gutters between and around the panels, no frames, no captions, no text, letters or numbers anywhere. Style: Children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolor and gouache with gentle pencil lines, warm golden light, earthy Middle-Eastern palette (sand, olive green, terracotta, sky blue), rounded friendly faces with expressive eyes, ancient Near-East setting of the Torah era: tents, desert hills, stone villages, simple wool and linen robes, head coverings, sandals. Calm, warm, safe mood. Keep every character exactly the same in every panel where they appear: Joseph: boy of 17, slim, brown curly hair, smiling warm brown eyes, no beard, olive skin, wearing his special long-sleeved coat of many colors with bright vertical stripes of red, blue, yellow and green over a cream tunic, leather sandals; Joseph in Egypt: the same Joseph, boy of 17 to 19, slim, brown curly hair, smiling warm brown eyes, no beard, olive skin, now in a plain knee-length cream linen tunic with a simple brown belt, barefoot or simple sandals; no striped coat; Jacob: Joseph's father, man about 65, grey curly hair, long grey beard with dark threads, kind brown eyes with smile lines, olive skin, olive-green wool robe with a brown rope belt, cream linen head cloth, wooden walking staff; Benjamin: Joseph's little brother, boy about 6, round cheeks, short brown curly hair, big brown eyes, cream tunic with a sky-blue sash, barefoot, often holding a little lamb; Brothers: Joseph's ten older brothers, shepherds aged 20 to 35, olive skin, dark hair, short dark beards, plain wool robes in brown, grey, rust, olive and dull blue, wooden shepherd staffs; Potiphar: Egyptian official, man about 45, tall, light-brown skin, clean-shaven, short black hair, white pleated linen kilt and robe, wide gold-and-turquoise collar necklace, gold armband; Warden: chief of the prison, plump Egyptian man about 50, light-brown skin, shaved head, friendly round face, plain white linen kilt and short robe, big ring of wooden keys on his belt; Cupbearer: Pharaoh's chief cupbearer, slim Egyptian man about 40, light-brown skin, clean-shaven, short black hair, worried thin face, plain off-white linen tunic of a prisoner, a thin gold earring; Baker: Pharaoh's chief baker, round Egyptian man about 45, light-brown skin, clean-shaven, plump cheeks, sad droopy eyes, plain off-white linen tunic of a prisoner, flour-dusted hands. Panels in reading order: 1 BOOK COVER: A sunny green pasture in Canaan. Joseph twirls happily in his new coat of many colors, arms spread wide, the red, blue, yellow and green stripes shining in the sunlight, his curls bouncing, a big joyful smile. Sheep graze around him and little Benjamin claps nearby. Behind on a hill, Jacob's tents. Wide shot centered on Joseph, bright warm morning light. 2 Morning in Canaan: big brown goat-hair tents among golden wheat fields and green hills. Jacob stands in a tent doorway waving as his sons head out with their flocks toward the pastures. Joseph, in a cream tunic, walks beside his father with a cheerful smile, and little Benjamin holds a lamb. Wide shot, soft golden sunrise light, peaceful family life. 3 In front of the tents, Jacob proudly holds up the shining striped coat for Joseph, who has just put it on and spins with delight. To the side, a group of brothers stands with sour faces, arms crossed, whispering to each other and glancing sideways. Medium-wide shot, bright daylight, the coat's colors glowing, the contrast between joy and jealousy. 4 A dream-like scene in a golden wheat field: tied bundles of wheat stand in a circle, and the bundles around bow gently toward one tall upright bundle in the middle, like a soft cartoon. In the lower corner, Joseph, in his striped coat, tells the dream excitedly with wide gestures to his brothers, who stare at him with annoyed, angry frowns. Split composition, warm wheat colors. 5 Night sky over the tents: a smiling sun, a silver moon and eleven bright stars are arranged in a gentle arc, all tilting down as if bowing, dreamy and soft. Below, Joseph in his striped coat points up, and Jacob, beside him, raises an eyebrow but has a thoughtful, quiet smile. At the side, the brothers' faces are shaded by a small grey cloud above their heads. Wide shot, deep blue and gold. 6 A wide, empty pasture at late afternoon under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, Joseph's striped coat lies alone, folded on a flat rock in the grass. The brothers walk away from it in the middle distance with heads down and slumped shoulders. Far away on the horizon, a small caravan of camels travels toward the south. No people near the coat, no blood. Wide shot, muted colors, sad and quiet. 7 A merchant caravan crosses a vast golden desert. Joseph, in a plain cream tunic, sits on the back of a camel loaded with bundles, turning to look back over his shoulder at the faraway green hills of home, his face sad and a little scared, a tear on his cheek. The evening sky glows with a gentle warm light above him. Medium-wide shot, long shadows, quiet hope. 8 A bright courtyard of a rich Egyptian house with palm trees, a lotus pool and storerooms. Joseph carries a basket of fruit and directs servants with a confident, kind smile. Potiphar stands on the steps watching with an approving nod, holding a ring of keys out toward Joseph. No statues of gods. Wide shot, sunny warm light, a sense of success and trust. 9 Inside a simple stone prison hall, dim but not frightening, with beams of sunlight from a small high window. Joseph kneels and offers a cup of water to an old prisoner sitting on a straw mat, with a gentle caring face. The warden, standing nearby with his keys, smiles and trusts him. Medium shot, warm light patches on cool stone walls.
